name: find_object
description: Find, track, and approach a named object as one complete goal. A scan may return a definitive target, one contextual clue to investigate, or no clue; no-clue searches use accumulated camera coverage to discover unvisited space and frontiers. Call once and use stop_goal to cancel.

target.description: The specific object to find and approach.

name: watch_target
description: Start continuous camera tracking. If succeeded, tracking remains active until stopped.

target.description: The specific person, body part, or object concerned by the request.
